subject: Priv deploy: proposed evidence & handoff playbook
messages:
From: Rachel Stone <rachel.stone@medcore.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: CloudBroker Solutions <sales@cloudbroker.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment evidence — initial ask

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement and our security team have asked for a concise plan for how Redwood will deliver evidence and proof-of-deployment artifacts (for the VPC/on‑prem option) ahead of signature. Specifically they want:

- A one-page runbook describing how keys, snapshots, and audit logs will be delivered or retained.
- A list of documents we can provide (SOC 2 extracts, sample audit logs, configuration inventory).
- An outline of any escrow/custody-like options you support or recommend for critical bits (e.g., boot images, compiled artifacts) if the customer requires long-term recoverability.

Can you share a short playbook we can circulate to legal and procurement? Timing: they'd like something by mid‑day Tuesday PT so they can include it in the internal approval packet.

Appreciate it — Rachael

Attachment(s): none

--
Rachel Stone
Head of Procurement — MedCore Health

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Stone <rachel.stone@medcore.com>
Cc: CloudBroker Solutions <sales@cloudbroker.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-05T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment evidence — initial ask

Hi Rachel —

Thanks — I put together a short draft playbook that covers evidence categories, proposed delivery windows, and an options matrix for custody/handback. High-level notes up front:

- We separate "operational evidence" (audit logs, metrics, config exports) from "custodial artifacts" (VM images, compiled runtime). For most customers, operational evidence plus configuration inventory satisfies the procurement checklist.
- Escrow-style handback is a process option we offer under Private contracts but it typically requires an Order Form addendum (scope + verification steps) and an SOW for transfer testing.
- Timeline we propose: initial evidence package 7 business days after countersignature; optional custodial transfer pilot within 30 days if required.

I'm attaching the draft playbook and will loop in Legal for any contractual framing. If you want, CloudBroker can be listed as a delivery partner in the playbook.

Attached: deploy-evidence-playbook-draft.pdf (3 pages)

Next steps: Laura — could you take a quick pass on the Terms section and flag anything we should not commit to in the Order Form? Neha — can you confirm what SOC2 extracts we can safely share and whether we need an NDA amendment for deeper logs?

Thanks,

Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai | +1 415‑555‑0192
--

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, rachel.stone@medcore.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-05T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment evidence — initial ask

Rachel / Jasmine —

Thanks for the draft. I reviewed the playbook and marked a few items that should not be baked into the base Order Form without Legal approval:

1) "Escrow-style handback: unconditional delivery of compiled runtime" — propose we change to "conditional transfer subject to successful verification testing and a formal transfer addendum."
2) Specific acceptance criteria for transferred artifacts need to be templated; do not provide unlimited test access to customer-owned keys during transfer — propose time‑boxed verification and mutually agreed test harness.
3) Limit liability language: if we run a custodial transfer exercise, ensure liability remains bounded and tied to an agreed checklist.

I've produced an inline redline of the MSA/Order Form language and attached it: MSA-redline-20261005.docx. Please note the redlines in Section 7 (License & Deployment Rights) and Section 12 (Audit & Evidence).

On timing: if MedCore wants escrow/custody options included in the signed Order Form, we will need a short commercial addendum and sign-off from Finance. Otherwise, we can treat custody transfer as a post-signature professional services engagement (preferred).

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
--
Attachment(s): MSA-redline-20261005.docx (redline)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, rachel.stone@medcore.com
Date: 2026-10-06T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment evidence — initial ask

All — quick note from Security:

- We can share SOC 2 extracts and a short sample of anonymized audit log records (attached) under the standard NDA. The attached soc2-extracts-20261003.pdf contains the control matrix and a redacted syslog sample.
- For full audit logs or KV cache snapshots we require either: (a) a scoped Data Access Agreement covering retention and use, or (b) a joint access session with our engineers (timeboxed).
- Regarding custodial artifacts: we do not hand over private signing keys or HSM materials. If MedCore insists on a recoverable runtime image, propose a documented escrow workflow: encrypted artifact stored with a neutral custodian, keys split and escrowed, transfer triggered by documented release conditions and verification tests. That workflow must be governed by an addendum.

Link to suggested escrow workflow doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdeFgHiJkLmNoP

Neha Kapoor
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
--
Attachment(s): soc2-extracts-20261003.pdf (2 pages)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Stone <rachel.stone@medcore.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: CloudBroker Solutions <sales@cloudbroker.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment evidence — initial ask

Rachel —

Thanks for the quick review, team. To keep MedCore moving toward signature, proposed immediate plan: 

1) Jasmine sends the consolidated playbook (attached) that: shows the 7-business-day evidence package, the scoped SOC2 extracts we'll provide by default, and the optional escrow workflow as a commercial addendum.
2) Laura: we'll reference the redlined language as an optional addendum in the Order Form and mark custodial transfer as "post-signature professional services unless addendum executed."
3) Neha: Security to provide the sample extracts and the drive link (done). Any request for full logs or snapshots will trigger a Data Access Agreement and an SOW.

Action items / timeline:
- By EOD Tuesday PT: finalize playbook language for procurement packet (I'm targeting EOD 2026-10-06).
- Within 24 hours of countersignature: deliver the operational evidence package as described.
- If MedCore elects escrow/custody: provide a costed SOW and transfer test window (30‑day pilot).

Attached: deploy-evidence-playbook-draft.pdf (consolidated v2)

Rachel, if that aligns, I'll send the consolidated file you can share with Procurement and copy your legal contact.

Best,

Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
